user.title: Price Heater
user.description: Turn a heater on or off based on room temperature and electricity price. Below the minimum temperature the heater always runs; at the maximum it always stops; in between it only heats while electricity is cheap.

data.name: Name
data.cheap_hours: Cheapest hours per day to heat
data.price_threshold: Always cheap at or below this price (optional)

data_description.price_sensor: Its state should be the current price. To use 'cheapest hours' it also needs today's price list as an attribute (raw_today, today or prices_today), as Nordpool (HACS), Energi Data Service and ENTSO-e provide.
data_description.min_temp: The heater is always on below this temperature, whatever the price.
data_description.max_temp: The heater is always off at or above this temperature.
data_description.hysteresis: Margin that stops the heater from flapping on and off around the limits.
data_description.cheap_hours: Heat during this many of today's cheapest hours (0 disables).
data_description.min_cycle_minutes: Protects relays and compressors. Minimum/maximum temperature limits ignore this.
data_description.power_sensor: A meter measuring the heater, e.g. a smart plug. Gives exact power, energy and cost.
data_description.heater_power: Without a meter: the heater's rated power, counted while it is on.

error.min_not_below_max: Minimum temperature must be lower than maximum temperature.
error.hysteresis_too_large: Hysteresis must be less than half the gap between minimum and maximum temperature.

abort.already_configured: This heater is already controlled by Price Heater.
